title: Battle of Szeged (1552)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Szeged (1552)", at revision 1370590258, opens: "The Battle of Szeged was a military engagement between the Ottomans and the Habsburg army in Szeged. The Habsburgs besieged the city Szeged; however, an Ottoman relief army arrived and defeated the Habsburgs. The Ottoman garrison massacred the rest of the army in the city." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q132528606, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1552 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
